tasks.title: Find and name the five great vessels
tasks.prompt: Start at the top of the scan. Navigate to the superior mediastinum just above the aortic arch, then place a named arrow in each of: right brachiocephalic vein, left brachiocephalic vein, brachiocephalic artery, left common carotid artery, left subclavian artery.

hints.text: Orientation: work in a mediastinal window, axial plane. The level you need is in the superior mediastinum, a little above the top of the aortic arch.

Relationships: the two brachiocephalic veins are the most anterior vessels (the left one crosses in front of the arteries); behind them the three arch branches line up from patient right to left — brachiocephalic artery, left common carotid, left subclavian.
Jumping into the accepted slice interval.
Showing the draft vessel outlines.
Reveal the reference, explanation and book figure.

tasks.explanation: At the five-vessel level the two brachiocephalic veins lie anteriorly and the three branches of the aortic arch lie behind them, right to left: brachiocephalic artery, left common carotid artery, left subclavian artery. The accepted level is a slice interval (here taken from AI vessel outlines not reviewed by a radiologist: all five present as separate cross-sections and above the arch), not one exact slice — patients differ. Level, vessel identity, side and position are graded separately; two arrows in one vessel count once. These outlines are unreviewed AI proposals: compare carefully, and record your own review in Author before trusting them as a key.

tasks.title: Navigate to the five-vessel level
tasks.prompt: Scroll from the top of the scan and stop on a slice at the five-vessel level. Then submit — your current slice is checked. Say which landmarks you used.

hints.text: Find the top of the aortic arch first, then go a little superior.
Jumping into the accepted interval.
Reveal.

tasks.explanation: The feedback tells you how many millimetres superior or inferior you were. The accepted interval comes from AI vessel outlines that no radiologist has reviewed, so it is a draft until you review it.

rubric.text: Named landmarks used: top of the aortic arch below, brachiocephalic veins anteriorly, three arch branches behind them

tasks.title: Navigate to the aortic arch level
tasks.prompt: Find the level where the aortic arch crosses from anterior-right to posterior-left, stop there and submit.

hints.text: The arch is the curved tube connecting the ascending aorta (anterior) to the descending aorta (left of the spine).
Jumping into the accepted interval.
Reveal.

tasks.explanation: Just below the five-vessel level, the arch appears as one continuous curved vessel across the mediastinum. (Draft interval derived from AI outlines, not reviewed by a radiologist.)
